name: Creamy Lemon Poppy Seed Dressing

instructions.primary_message: In a small pitcher, squeeze bottle, or jar, combine fresh lemon syrup, oil, buttermilk, lemon juice, salt, poppy seeds, and black pepper. Stir or close lid and shake well to combine, then adjust seasoning to taste. Use immediately to dress a salad, or refrigerate in an airtight container up to 1 month.

schema_metadata.keywords: buttermilk, poppy seed, salad dressing, vinaigrette

description: With aromatic fresh lemon syrup and tangy buttermilk as its foundation, this sweet 'n sour dressing is a great way to lighten up summer salads, whether served on their own or alongside heavier fare. I love it tossed with baby greens, diced mango, and candied pistachios.
notes:
Optional substitutions: safflower oil → pistachio oil or whatever salad oil you prefer; poppy seeds → more to taste

Notes: Since poppy seeds are the star of the show, make sure yours are up to snuff! Check the expiration date on the package, or have a quick taste—they should be crisp and nutty. If yours are mushy or bland, it's time to invest in a fresh batch. Look for brands that are minimally processed, like Sincerely Nuts, which retain more of their inherently nutty flavor.
author: Stella Parks
